p10_b2.ocr: In Q1 2025, the program recorded a notable increase in New Sign-ups, reaching 150,000, which reflects ongoing interest in membership benefits and incentives. Moreover, the loyalty program has successfully maintained a Churn Rate of 5.0%, indicating a strong retention strategy that encourages repeat patronage. The financial metrics associated with the program reveal a robust Average Transaction value of ¥3,600, suggesting that engaged members tend to spend more per visit.

p10_b3.ocr: The Repeat Purchase Rate further exemplifies this trend, standing at an impressive 77.5%, which highlights the effectiveness of loyalty initiatives in fostering consistent consumer behavior. However, the investment in the loyalty program has incurred Program Costs amounting to ¥480M, necessitating ongoing analysis to ensure sustainable profitability.
